Card Q&A.q: This card has an effect that has both [On Play] and [When Digivolving] timings. What does this mean, exactly?
Can I digivolve one of my [Lucemon] in the battle area into this card in the hand when an effect to digivolve one of my Digimon is activated?

Effect: Your [Lucemon] can digivolve into this card in your hand for a memory cost of 7, ignoring this card's digivolution requirements.
For every 10 cards in your trash, reduce the memory cost when playing this card from your hand by 3.
[On Play][When Digivolving] Delete 1 of your opponent's Tamers or level 6 or lower Digimon.
